title: Occurrence Propositions For Semisimple Types
body_html:
Occurrence Propositions For Semisimple Types

The theta draft states two opening propositions.

First, for $x\in B(G^0)$,

$$ \omega[\phi_{\Sigma,x}]\ne 0 $$

if and only if there exists $w\in W$ such that

$$ M(w)=\beta. $$

It further states that

$$ \omega[\phi_{\Sigma,x}] = \left( \mathcal H(G') \sum_{\bar x'\in\mathcal C(Z_{G'})} \omega_{x,(x'^+,\bar x'),w} \right)[\phi_{\Sigma,x}]. $$

Second, for corresponding semisimple data $\Sigma,\Sigma'$, the draft states a canonical isomorphism

$$ \omega[\phi_{\Sigma,x}\otimes\phi_{\Sigma',x'}] \cong \left( R[{}^+G_{x,0^+}\backslash {}^+G/{}^+G_{x,0^+}] \otimes \omega^0{}^{Z_{G,x,0+}\times Z_{G',x',0+}} \right) \otimes (\kappa\boxtimes\kappa'). $$

Draft Caution

The notation in these propositions is not yet self-contained in the current TeX. In particular, $\phi_{\Sigma,x}$, $x'^+$, $\omega^0$, and the precise meaning of corresponding data $\Sigma,\Sigma'$ still need standalone definitions.
